name: trace_symbol
description: Trace a symbol's value and find all references including suspected hardcoded literal copies. Uses code-index refs table for direct references, then scans files for literal values to detect hardcoded duplicates. The literals search is text-based with a confidence heuristic (comment/string filtering). Useful before modifying constants or refactoring variable names.

workspace_dir.description: REQUIRED: Absolute path to the project root directory. Call reindex first.

file.description: File path relative to workspace_dir where the symbol is defined (e.g. "src/config.py")

include_literals.description: Search for hardcoded literal values across the project (default: false, slower)
